transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... mostly work stuff. My supervisor told me I needed to come in. He said it's becoming a safety problem because I keep... leaving my station. Or I'll just pop up during meetings when I'm supposed to stay put. I just kind of take off before I even think about it, I guess.
What is the sensation or feeling you experience right before you get up?

Um... I don't really know how to explain it. It's just... like a pressure, I guess. 

If I try to just stand still by my machine, or if I have to sit through training... it just feels like this pressure builds up in my body. And I just have to move, or pace, or do something right then.
Have you recently started, stopped, or changed the dose of any medications?
Um... no. I don't take anything.
Did you have this same kind of restlessness or trouble sitting still when you were a child?

Yeah... I guess so. 

Um, even back in elementary school, I was always the kid who couldn't just stay in my seat. I'd talk over the teacher... get notes sent home because I kept blurting stuff out or just wandering around the classroom. It's always been like this.
Besides having trouble sitting still, do you also struggle with things like paying close attention to details, staying focused on tasks, or being easily distracted?

Um... yeah, I guess so. Like... when I'm on the line at work. If another machine beeps, or... someone just walks past with a pallet jack... it just pulls my eyes away. 

My whole brain just goes to that, even though I know I'm supposed to stay on my own station. It just... happens.
